svg.title: VMware vSphere 9.1 logical architecture
svg.desc: Logical architecture showing workloads above a vCenter management plane and cluster services, a three-host ESX cluster with VMkernel services, separate virtual networking and storage domains, cross-cutting security and lifecycle controls, and the underlying physical infrastructure.
svg.text: Centralized management and policy with distributed workload execution across ESX hosts
